program:
PARAMS = {
    "I":    (10e-6, 4e-6, 30e-6),      # control starving current at vmid [A]
    "I0":   (3e-6, 1e-6, 8e-6),        # fixed floor current per starver [A]
    "Ls":   (0.5, 0.15, 1.5),          # starver length [um]
    "Wr":   (0.42, 0.42, 1.5),         # ring NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
    "Cr":   (6e-15, 1e-15, 20e-15),    # extra cap per ring node
    "Wb2":  (0.42, 0.42, 2.0),         # output inverter NMOS width (PMOS = 2x)
    "Cff":  (8e-15, 2e-15, 25e-15),    # feed-forward cap b1 -> vout (rail overshoot)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vdd = 1.8
    vr = spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4])
    vlo, vhi = vr[0], vr[1]
    vmid = 0.5 * (vlo + vhi)
    cl = spec.get("cl", 10e-15)
    Lmin = 0.15
    I, Ls, I0 = p["I"], p["Ls"], p["I0"]

    # control starver: gm/Id chosen so vgs = vmid at current I
    g_lo, g_hi = 2.0, 20.0
    for k in range(8):
        g = math.sqrt(g_lo * g_hi)
        t = lut.size("n", g, Ls, I, vds=0.4)
        if t.vgs > vmid:
            g_lo = g
        else:
            g_hi = g
    gmn = math.sqrt(g_lo * g_hi)
    msn = lut.size("n", gmn, Ls, I, vds=0.4)

    # floor device: W=0.42, gate at VDD, built as a series stack (each L<=20um)
    Wf = 0.42
    Lmax = 20.0
    id20 = lut.op("n", Wf, Lmax, vdd, 0.4)["Id"]
    if id20 <= I0:
        # single device suffices: bisection within [0.5, 20]
        lo_L, hi_L = 0.5, Lmax
        for k in range(12):
            Lt = math.sqrt(lo_L * hi_L)
            idf = lut.op("n", Wf, Lt, vdd, 0.4)["Id"]
            if idf > I0:
                lo_L = Lt
            else:
                hi_L = Lt
        nst = 1
        Lseg = round(min(Lmax, math.sqrt(lo_L * hi_L)), 2)
    else:
        Ltot = Lmax * id20 / I0          # Id ~ 1/L
        nst = int(math.ceil(Ltot / Lmax))
        Lseg = round(min(Lmax, Ltot / nst), 2)

    def floor_stack(name, top):
        nodes_f = [top] + ["%s_x%d" % (name, j) for j in range(nst - 1)] + ["vss"]
        for j in range(nst):
            n.M("%s_%d" % (name, j), nodes_f[j], "vdd", nodes_f[j + 1], "vss", "nfet", Wf, Lseg)

    Itot = I + I0
    mpb = lut.size("p", 8, Ls, Itot, vds=0.9)
    mps = lut.size("p", 8, Ls, Itot, vds=0.4)

    Wrn = p["Wr"]; Wrp = 2.0 * Wrn
    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    n.dev("MNB", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", msn)
    floor_stack("MFB", "pb")
    n.dev("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mpb)

    nodes = ["r0", "r1", "r2"]
    for i in range(3):
        a = nodes[i]; y = nodes[(i + 1) % 3]
        sp = "sp%d" % i; sn = "sn%d" % i
        n.dev("MPS%d" % i, sp, "pb", "vdd", "vdd", mps)
        n.M("MP%d" % i, y, a, sp, "vdd", "pfet", Wrp, Lmin)
        n.M("MN%d" % i, y, a, sn, "vss", "nfet", Wrn, Lmin)
        n.dev("MNS%d" % i, sn, "vctrl", "vss", "vss", msn)
        floor_stack("MF%d" % i, sn)
        n.C("CR%d" % i, y, "vss", p["Cr"])

    # sharpening buffer chain
    n.M("MB1P", "b0", "r0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.84, Lmin)
    n.M("MB1N", "b0", "r0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, Lmin)
    n.M("MB0P", "b1", "b0", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 1.68, Lmin)
    n.M("MB0N", "b1", "b0", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.84, Lmin)
    Wn2 = p["Wb2"]; Wp2 = 2.0 * Wn2
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp2, Lmin)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn2, Lmin)
    n.C("CFF", "b1", "vout", p["Cff"])

    # ---- predictions ----
    cox = 8.5e-15; cov = 0.35e-15
    def cg(W, L): return W * L * cox + 2 * W * cov
    c_node = cg(Wrp, Lmin) + cg(Wrn, Lmin) + (Wrp + Wrn) * 0.9e-15 + 0.5e-15 + p["Cr"]
    c_r0 = c_node + cg(0.84, Lmin) + cg(0.42, Lmin)
    cavg = (2 * c_node + c_r0) / 3
    vth = msn.vth
    vgsm = max(msn.vgs, vth + 0.05)
    def istarve(vc):
        vov = max(vc - vth, 0.0); vovm = vgsm - vth
        return I * (vov / vovm) ** 1.5 + I0
    kemp = 2.3
    def freq(vc):
        Is = istarve(vc)
        return kemp / (3 * cavg * vdd / Is + 3 * 25e-12)
    f_lo, f_mid, f_hi = freq(vlo), freq(vmid), freq(vhi)

    c_b0 = cg(1.68, Lmin) + cg(0.84, Lmin) + 1.2e-15
    c_b1 = cg(Wp2, Lmin) + cg(Wn2, Lmin) + 2.0e-15 + p["Cff"]
    c_out = cl + (Wp2 + Wn2) * 0.9e-15 + p["Cff"]
    c_sw = 3 * c_node + (c_r0 - c_node) + c_b0 + c_b1 + c_out
    power = 1.4 * c_sw * vdd ** 2 * f_mid + vdd * istarve(vmid)
    cgd2 = (Wp2 + Wn2) * cov
    kick = (p["Cff"] + cgd2) / (p["Cff"] + cgd2 + c_out) * vdd * 0.3
    swing = vdd + 2 * kick
    return n, {"f_lo": f_lo, "f_mid": f_mid, "f_hi": f_hi,
               "swing": swing, "power": power}
